sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium, and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本集最初作为给付费订阅者的早期福利，发布在Casefile的Patreon、Apple Premium和Spotify Premium频道上。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些剧集篇幅稍短，旨在让我们能够涵盖更广泛的案件。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 如需抢先收听这些无广告剧集，您可以在您偏好的平台上支持Casefile。

sentences.en: Well folks, here's my new backyard, said 47-year-old Nadia Medley as she filmed her surroundings with her smartphone.
sentences.zh: “伙计们，这是我的新后院。”47岁的娜迪亚·梅德利（Nadia Medley）用智能手机拍摄周围环境时说道。

sentences.en: It was Wednesday, May 10, 2017, and Nadia stood alone in the middle of a sprawling paddock on the rural outskirts of Caldwell, Idaho.
sentences.zh: 那是2017年5月10日，星期三，娜迪亚独自站在爱达荷州考德威尔（Caldwell）郊区一片广阔的牧场中央。

sentences.en: Nadia slowly panned her phone, capturing the overgrown grass and wildflowers that encircled her.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚缓慢地移动手机镜头，拍摄着环绕在她周围杂草丛生的草地和野花。

sentences.en: In the distance were trees and the fences of neighbouring properties.
sentences.zh: 远处是树木和邻近房产的围栏。

sentences.en: There wasn't a cloud in the blue sky and all was silent aside from the gentle sounds of birds chirping.
sentences.zh: 蓝天万里无云，除了鸟儿清脆的鸣叫声，四周一片寂静。

sentences.en: Kind of liking this just a little bit, Nadia remarked.
sentences.zh: “我有点喜欢这里。”娜迪亚评论道。

sentences.en: She honed in on a run-down fence with broken wires that needed fixing.
sentences.zh: 她将镜头对准了一处需要修理的破旧围栏，上面的铁丝已经断裂。

sentences.en: Nadia explained that rebuilding it was one of the projects she had to work on.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚解释说，重建围栏是她需要完成的项目之一。

sentences.en: At her feet was one of her three pet dogs, sniffing and chewing on grass.
sentences.zh: 在她的脚边，她养的三只狗中的一只正在嗅着并啃食草地。

sentences.en: Dogs are the only thing that's grazing now, Nadia joked.
sentences.zh: “现在只有狗在吃草。”娜迪亚开玩笑道。

sentences.en: But that will change.
sentences.zh: “但这种情况很快会改变。”

sentences.en: The land had so many trees that the house where Nadia lived wasn't visible from where she was standing.
sentences.zh: 这片土地上树木繁多，以至于娜迪亚所站的位置根本看不见她居住的房子。

sentences.en: The pleasure she took in the peaceful country home was evident in her voice as she narrated her video tour of the property.
sentences.zh: 当她解说这段房产视频时，声音中流露出她对这个宁静乡村家园的喜爱。

sentences.en: Nadia filmed the farm's henhouse where their chickens were kept, before pausing on a small building further away.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚拍摄了农场的鸡舍，随后镜头在一座远处的小建筑上停顿了一下。

sentences.en: Just one week earlier, Nadia had moved to the Caldwell farm from her previous home in the city of Ogden, Utah.
sentences.zh: 就在一周前，娜迪亚刚从犹他州奥格登（Ogden）的旧居搬到了考德威尔的这个农场。

sentences.en: She kept her friends back in Utah up to date on her new life in Idaho via her Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 她通过Facebook页面向犹他州的朋友们更新她在爱达荷州的新生活。

sentences.en: There, they could watch the video Nadia filmed of her new backyard.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们可以看到娜迪亚拍摄的新后院视频。

sentences.en: It looks right down your alley, her friend commented.
sentences.zh: “这看起来很适合你。”一位朋友评论道。

sentences.en: That's so pretty, wrote another.
sentences.zh: “太美了。”另一位写道。

sentences.en: It's a ton of work, Nadia admitted, but added that she was loving Idaho already.
sentences.zh: “这需要做很多工作，”娜迪亚承认，但补充说她已经爱上了爱达荷州。

sentences.en: A few days later, Nadia posted a photograph of her front yard being pelted with rain during a storm.
sentences.zh: 几天后，娜迪亚发布了一张照片，显示她的前院在暴风雨中被大雨倾盆冲刷。

sentences.en: On Thursday May 18, one of Nadia's dogs clambered onto a tree with her as she took a break from all the yard work.
sentences.zh: 5月18日星期四，娜迪亚在忙完庭院工作休息时，她的一只狗和她一起爬上了一棵树。

sentences.en: She shared a photo of this too, writing,
sentences.zh: 她也分享了这张照片，并写道：

sentences.en: This silly dog climbed a tree with us today.
sentences.zh: “今天这只傻狗和我们一起爬上了树。”

sentences.en: A month into her time in Caldwell, Nadia completed a survey of 34 questions about her likes and dislikes.
sentences.zh: 搬到考德威尔一个月后，娜迪亚完成了一份关于她喜好和厌恶的34题问卷调查。

sentences.en: She posted the results to her Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 她将结果发布到了自己的Facebook页面上。

sentences.en: Question 25 asked,
sentences.zh: 第25个问题问道：

sentences.en: Are you where you want to be in life?
sentences.zh: “你现在的生活是你想要的吗？”

sentences.en: Nadia's answer to this was simply, yes.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚的回答很简单：是的。

sentences.en: Nadia was originally from Germany.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚来自德国。

sentences.en: She had immigrated to the United States on her own, where she met and married an American man named Todd Medley.
sentences.zh: 她独自移民到美国，在那里遇到了美国人托德·梅德利（Todd Medley）并与他结婚。

sentences.en: The two worked together in a pet store.
sentences.zh: 两人曾在一家宠物店一起工作。

sentences.en: They also bred small animals at their home to make extra money.
sentences.zh: 他们还在家里繁育小动物以赚取额外收入。

sentences.en: In 2002, the couple had their first child, a girl they named Peyton.
sentences.zh: 2002年，这对夫妇有了第一个孩子，一个名叫佩顿（Peyton）的女孩。

sentences.en: Almost a decade later, in 2011, Nadia gave birth to her second child, who died shortly thereafter.
sentences.zh: 近十年后的2011年，娜迪亚生下了第二个孩子，但孩子不久后便夭折了。

sentences.en: Three years later, in 2014, while Nadia was still dealing with the loss of her baby, Todd suffered a heart attack and died.
sentences.zh: 三年后的2014年，当娜迪亚还在承受丧子之痛时，托德突发心脏病去世了。

sentences.en: With no other family in the United States, apart from Todd's relatives who lived interstate,
sentences.zh: 除了住在外州的托德的亲戚外，她在美再无其他亲人。

sentences.en: Nadia and Peyton grew extremely close.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚和佩顿的关系变得极其亲密。

sentences.en: They bonded over their love of animals and did fun activities together, such as swimming and picnicking.
sentences.zh: 她们因对动物的共同热爱而结缘，并一起进行游泳和野餐等有趣的活动。

sentences.en: Nadia described Peyton as one of her favourite people.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚称佩顿是她最喜欢的人之一。

sentences.en: When two short stories that Peyton had written were published in her school's annual writing anthology, Nadia was incredibly proud.
sentences.zh: 当佩顿写的两篇短篇小说发表在学校的年度文集上时，娜迪亚感到无比自豪。

sentences.en: Despite her deep connection with her daughter, Nadia still struggled.
sentences.zh: 尽管与女儿关系深厚，娜迪亚的生活依然艰难。

sentences.en: Utah felt like a strange place to her at times.
sentences.zh: 犹他州有时让她感到陌生。

sentences.en: Nadia loved the state's natural beauty, but as a staunch atheist, she found its overwhelmingly religious culture quite foreign.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚热爱该州的自然美景，但作为一名坚定的无神论者，她觉得当地浓厚的宗教文化非常格格不入。

sentences.en: The headquarters of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints were in Utah, and many of Nadia's neighbours in Ogden were church members.
sentences.zh: 耶稣基督后期圣徒教会的总部就在犹他州，娜迪亚在奥格登的许多邻居都是教会成员。

sentences.en: Finances were also a difficulty.
sentences.zh: 经济也是一个难题。

sentences.en: Todd hadn't left behind any money when he died, and now Nadia was a sole provider.
sentences.zh: 托德去世时没有留下任何钱，现在娜迪亚成了唯一的经济支柱。

sentences.en: She began working as a massage therapist at an Ogden spa.
sentences.zh: 她开始在奥格登的一家水疗中心担任按摩治疗师。

sentences.en: One day in 2015, a man in his late 50s arrived for an appointment.
sentences.zh: 2015年的一天，一位50多岁的男子前来预约。

sentences.en: His name was Mike Bollinger, and despite the age difference, Nadia felt a spark right away.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫迈克·博林格（Mike Bollinger），尽管年龄有差距，娜迪亚还是立刻对他产生了好感。

sentences.en: Mike was warm and charming with a wide smile.
sentences.zh: 迈克热情迷人，笑容灿烂。

sentences.en: Both loved hiking and exploring the graveyard doors.
sentences.zh: 两人都喜欢徒步旅行和探索墓地。

sentences.en: Mike was also an atheist, and his values aligned with Nadia's.
sentences.zh: 迈克也是一名无神论者，他的价值观与娜迪亚不谋而合。

sentences.en: The two soon began dating.
sentences.zh: 两人很快开始约会。

sentences.en: Nadia's friends were thrilled for her.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚的朋友们为她感到高兴。

sentences.en: It was clear that Mike had brought happiness back into her life.
sentences.zh: 很明显，迈克让她的生活重新焕发了幸福。

sentences.en: He was also great with Peyton, sometimes picking her up from school or taking her out for lunch.
sentences.zh: 他对佩顿也很好，有时会去学校接她，或者带她出去吃午饭。

sentences.en: He became something of a father figure, teaching Peyton outdoor skills like shooting or playing with her in the autumn leaves.
sentences.zh: 他成了某种意义上的父亲形象，教佩顿射击等户外技能，或者在秋叶中陪她玩耍。

sentences.en: Peyton seemed to adore Mike almost as much as her mother, and soon she'd started calling him dad.
sentences.zh: 佩顿似乎像爱母亲一样爱着迈克，很快她就开始叫他爸爸了。

sentences.en: Mike, Nadia and Peyton attended concerts and festivals together, went to the baseball, and hiked and camped in Yellowstone National Park.
sentences.zh: 迈克、娜迪亚和佩顿一起参加音乐会和节日庆典，去看棒球比赛，还在黄石国家公园徒步和露营。

sentences.en: Because Mike worked as a pilot, he often had to travel for a few days at a time.
sentences.zh: 由于迈克是一名飞行员，他经常需要出差几天。

sentences.en: He made up for his absence by taking Nadia and Peyton on vacations or other adventures that Nadia documented on her Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 他通过带娜迪亚和佩顿去度假或其他冒险来弥补自己的缺席，娜迪亚会将这些经历记录在Facebook页面上。

sentences.en: By the beginning of 2017, Nadia and Mike had been together for almost 18 months.
sentences.zh: 到2017年初，娜迪亚和迈克已经在一起近18个月了。

sentences.en: Things were going so well that Nadia felt ready to ask Mike an awkward question.
sentences.zh: 一切进展顺利，娜迪亚觉得可以问迈克一个尴尬的问题了。

sentences.en: Her single income wasn't a lot, and she was having trouble making her mortgage payments.
sentences.zh: 她单薄的收入并不多，支付抵押贷款有些吃力。

sentences.en: Nadia had seen Mike's paycheck and knew he made more than $10,000 a month, so she wondered if he might be able to help her out financially.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚看过迈克的工资单，知道他月薪超过1万美元，所以她想知道他是否能在经济上帮她一把。

sentences.en: Mike was troubled by the question.
sentences.zh: 迈克对这个问题感到困扰。

sentences.en: He had divorced his wife a decade earlier, and Nadia was the first woman he'd been involved with since then.
sentences.zh: 他十年前与前妻离婚，娜迪亚是他那之后交往的第一个女人。

sentences.en: Becoming financially entangled with another seemed far too serious for him, and he worried that the relationship was moving more quickly than he was ready for.
sentences.zh: 与他人产生经济纠葛对他来说似乎太严肃了，他担心这段关系的发展速度超出了他的心理准备。

sentences.en: After a conversation about the matter, the couple broke up.
sentences.zh: 在就此事进行交谈后，两人分手了。

sentences.en: Mike had recently been offered more consistent work based out of Boise, the capital city of Idaho.
sentences.zh: 迈克最近得到了一份更稳定的工作，基地位于爱达荷州首府博伊西（Boise）。

sentences.en: He'd purchased a run-down farm in the city of Caldwell, about 28 miles west of Boise.
sentences.zh: 他在距离博伊西以西约28英里的考德威尔市买下了一个破旧的农场。

sentences.en: The property was around one and a half acres, and it had a fully equipped farmhouse that was built in 1964.
sentences.zh: 该房产占地约1.5英亩，有一栋建于1964年的设施齐全的农舍。

sentences.en: From the outside, it looked like a modest weatherboard home, but it had four bedrooms and two bathrooms, as well as a spacious kitchen.
sentences.zh: 从外观上看，它像是一栋朴素的木板房，但内部有四间卧室、两间浴室以及一个宽敞的厨房。

sentences.en: As he was nearing retirement age, Mike thought the property would be a scenic spot to live out his golden years.
sentences.zh: 随着退休年龄临近，迈克认为这里将是他安享晚年的风景胜地。

sentences.en: The farm needed lots of work, but it was a project Mike was keen to take on.
sentences.zh: 农场需要大量修缮，但这正是迈克乐于承担的项目。

sentences.en: Yet, not having Nadia in his life made Mike realise what he'd be giving up if their relationship didn't progress further.
sentences.zh: 然而，生活中没有了娜迪亚，让迈克意识到如果他们的关系不再进一步，他会失去什么。

sentences.en: Despite no longer being a couple, they had stayed in touch and still spoke regularly.
sentences.zh: 尽管不再是情侣，他们仍保持联系并经常交谈。

sentences.en: Both of them missed one another and found being apart very difficult.
sentences.zh: 两人都非常想念对方，觉得分开的日子很难熬。

sentences.en: Within a few weeks, they decided to get back together.
sentences.zh: 几周之内，他们决定复合。

sentences.en: Proving how serious he was about their relationship, Mike asked Nadia and Peyton to live in Caldwell with him.
sentences.zh: 为了证明他对这段关系的认真态度，迈克邀请娜迪亚和佩顿搬到考德威尔和他一起住。

sentences.en: Nadia accepted his offer.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚接受了他的邀请。

sentences.en: She looked forward to settling in the countryside and starting a new phase of their lives as a family.
sentences.zh: 她期待着在乡村定居，开启他们一家人生活的新篇章。

sentences.en: The setting also suited the animal-loving Peyton, who would have plenty of room for all her pets, which included dogs, cats, rabbits, chickens, birds, fish, and one snake.
sentences.zh: 这个环境也很适合热爱动物的佩顿，她有足够的空间安置所有的宠物，包括狗、猫、兔子、鸡、鸟、鱼和一条蛇。

sentences.en: She and Nadia planned to raise livestock and keep horses on the land.
sentences.zh: 她和娜迪亚计划在土地上饲养牲畜和马匹。

sentences.en: In late March 2017, Nadia shared the news of her upcoming move interstate on Facebook, posting,
sentences.zh: 2017年3月下旬，娜迪亚在Facebook上分享了即将搬到外州的消息，写道：

sentences.en: Just over a month later on Thursday May 4 2017, Nadia and Peyton headed north to join Mike in Idaho.
sentences.zh: 一个多月后的2017年5月4日星期四，娜迪亚和佩顿北上前往爱达荷州与迈克团聚。

sentences.en: With spring in full bloom, the Caldwell Farm was green and covered in wildflowers.
sentences.zh: 春意盎然，考德威尔农场绿意葱茏，开满了野花。

sentences.en: Nadia and Peyton loved it from the moment they arrived.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚和佩顿从抵达的那一刻起就爱上了这里。

sentences.en: They and Mike spent a lot of time outdoors, working on the repairs that needed to be done around the property.
sentences.zh: 他们和迈克花了很多时间在户外，修缮房产周围需要维护的地方。

sentences.en: Nadia posted photos and videos of her country life online, while encouraging her friends to visit any time.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚在网上发布了乡村生活的照片和视频，并鼓励朋友们随时来访。

sentences.en: On Friday June 9, Nadia was scheduled to drive to Utah to pick up some horses for the farm.
sentences.zh: 6月9日星期五，娜迪亚原定开车去犹他州为农场接回一些马匹。

sentences.en: But she never arrived.
sentences.zh: 但她从未到达。

sentences.en: Wondering what was going on, the horse sellers tried calling her cell phone.
sentences.zh: 卖马的人觉得奇怪，便尝试拨打她的手机。

sentences.en: There was no answer.
sentences.zh: 无人接听。

sentences.en: It all seemed a bit strange, but as the sellers didn't know Nadia well, they didn't think much of it.
sentences.zh: 这一切看起来有点奇怪，但由于卖家和娜迪亚不太熟，他们并没有多想。

sentences.en: As well as being an enthusiastic social media user, Nadia was reliable and replied to messages quickly.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚不仅是一位热衷于社交媒体的用户，而且为人可靠，回复消息也很及时。

sentences.en: When her friends stopped hearing from her, they wondered if something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 当朋友们不再收到她的消息时，他们开始担心是否出了什么事。

sentences.en: Peyton's friends noticed that she'd fallen silent too.
sentences.zh: 佩顿的朋友们也注意到她也变得沉默了。

sentences.en: The last time she'd replied to a text message was on Thursday June 8.
sentences.zh: 她最后一次回复短信是在6月8日星期四。

sentences.en: As she was ordinarily glued to her phone, this seemed rather odd.
sentences.zh: 由于她平时手机不离手，这显得相当反常。

sentences.en: Still, it was the summer, and she'd just moved to a new place, so they wondered if maybe she was just busy working outdoors and caring for her animals.
sentences.zh: 不过，现在是夏天，她刚搬到新地方，所以他们猜测她可能只是忙于户外工作和照顾动物。

sentences.en: Mike's family hadn't heard from him either.
sentences.zh: 迈克的家人也没有他的消息。

sentences.en: He had two sons from a previous marriage, and neither had spoken to him in days.
sentences.zh: 他与前妻育有两个儿子，两人已经好几天没和他说话了。

sentences.en: When more than a week had passed with no word from the Cordwell Farm, authorities were asked to perform a welfare check.
sentences.zh: 当考德威尔农场一周多没有音讯后，当局被要求进行福利检查。

sentences.en: Deputies from the county sheriff's department arrived at the property on Monday June 19.
sentences.zh: 6月19日星期一，县治安官部门的副警长抵达了该房产。

sentences.en: The area was eerily quiet.
sentences.zh: 该地区安静得令人毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: There was also a foul odour in the air.
sentences.zh: 空气中还弥漫着一股恶臭。

sentences.en: The deputies entered the farmhouse, calling out to anyone who might be inside.
sentences.zh: 副警长们进入农舍，呼喊着屋内可能存在的任何人。

sentences.en: But there was no reply.
sentences.zh: 但无人应答。

sentences.en: Although there were no people in the house, the deputies did find the bodies of several dead dogs, cats, and pet birds.
sentences.zh: 虽然屋内没有人，但副警长们发现了多具死去的狗、猫和宠物鸟的尸体。

sentences.en: It appeared as though the animals had starved to death.
sentences.zh: 这些动物似乎是饿死的。

sentences.en: Other pets, including some rabbits and a snake, were still alive.
sentences.zh: 其他一些宠物，包括几只兔子和一条蛇，还活着。

sentences.en: Outside, the deputies checked the henhouse.
sentences.zh: 在外面，副警长们检查了鸡舍。

sentences.en: It was full of dead chickens.
sentences.zh: 里面全是死鸡。

sentences.en: They too had apparently died of starvation.
sentences.zh: 它们显然也是饿死的。

sentences.en: Not far from the henhouse was a hayshed.
sentences.zh: 离鸡舍不远的地方有一个干草棚。

sentences.en: The worst smell seemed to be emanating from there.
sentences.zh: 最难闻的气味似乎就是从那里散发出来的。

sentences.en: Inside, the deputies discovered a blue tarp covering something on the floor.
sentences.zh: 在里面，副警长们发现了一块蓝色防水布，覆盖着地板上的某种东西。

sentences.en: Underneath were the bodies of three people, decomposed beyond recognition due to the summer heat.
sentences.zh: 下面是三具尸体，由于夏季的高温，尸体已经腐烂到无法辨认。

sentences.zh: Casefile稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集赞助商的内容，以此支持我们。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集的广告。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持Casefile继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: When a teacher by the name of Cheryl Baker was in her late 40s, she caught a flight to Alaska and found herself seated next to a very engaging man.
sentences.zh: 当一位名叫谢丽尔·贝克（Cheryl Baker）的教师40多岁时，她乘飞机前往阿拉斯加，发现自己坐在一位非常有魅力的男士旁边。

sentences.en: Gerald was warm and friendly, and the two hit it off.
sentences.zh: 杰拉德（Gerald）热情友好，两人一见如故。

sentences.en: They wound up exchanging phone numbers and began dating when they were both back at home in Utah.
sentences.zh: 他们最终交换了电话号码，并在回到犹他州的家中后开始约会。

sentences.en: In 2010, when Cheryl was 50 and Gerald was 53, they married.
sentences.zh: 2010年，当谢丽尔50岁、杰拉德53岁时，他们结婚了。

sentences.en: Cheryl, who was artistic and creative, made her own wedding dress.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔富有艺术感和创造力，她亲手制作了自己的婚纱。

sentences.en: The two had a lot in common.
sentences.zh: 两人有很多共同点。

sentences.en: Both enjoyed travelling, hiking and horseback riding.
sentences.zh: 他们都喜欢旅行、徒步和骑马。

sentences.en: Cheryl practiced Hinduism and attended the Sri Ganesha Temple of Utah.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔信奉印度教，经常去犹他州的斯里加尼什神庙（Sri Ganesha Temple）。

sentences.en: Gerald took an interest in the faith and would go to the temple with her.
sentences.zh: 杰拉德对这种信仰产生了兴趣，并会陪她去神庙。

sentences.en: He even ended up learning Sanskrit, a classical language of South Asia, so he could better understand the Hindu texts.
sentences.zh: 他甚至最终学会了南亚的古典语言——梵语，以便更好地理解印度教经文。

sentences.en: But the couple had their differences too.
sentences.zh: 但这对夫妇也有分歧。

sentences.en: Gerald knew a lot about surviving in the wilderness and would sometimes act as a guide for hunting parties.
sentences.zh: 杰拉德非常了解野外生存知识，有时会担任狩猎队的向导。

sentences.en: Cheryl hated guns and would have to leave the room whenever Gerald returned from one of these trips.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔讨厌枪支，每当杰拉德从这些旅行中回来时，她都不得不离开房间。

sentences.en: She couldn't stand being in the same space while Gerald cleaned his firearMs.
sentences.zh: 她无法忍受在杰拉德清理枪支时待在同一个空间里。

sentences.en: Overall though, the couple's friends and family were struck by how happy they seemed.
sentences.zh: 不过总的来说，这对夫妇的朋友和家人都被他们表现出的幸福所打动。

sentences.en: In 2016, six years after their wedding, Cheryl and Gerald went on a rafting vacation together.
sentences.zh: 2016年，在他们结婚六年后，谢丽尔和杰拉德一起去漂流度假。

sentences.en: When they returned, Cheryl was glowing as though she'd just been on her honeymoon.
sentences.zh: 当他们回来时，谢丽尔容光焕发，就像刚度完蜜月一样。

sentences.en: She raved about what a wonderful time she and Gerald had together.
sentences.zh: 她兴致勃勃地谈论着她和杰拉德在一起度过的美好时光。

sentences.en: At around this time, Cheryl was in her late 50s and had been a teacher for almost four decades.
sentences.zh: 那段时间，谢丽尔已年近六旬，从事教师工作近四十年了。

sentences.en: In 2017, she taught at Greenwood Charter School in Harrisville, a city just a few miles north of her home in Ogden.
sentences.zh: 2017年，她在哈里斯维尔的格林伍德特许学校任教，那座城市距离她位于奥格登的家仅几英里。

sentences.en: Gerald worked as a charter pilot, so he was sometimes away for days at a time, but he'd been offered a more stable job based out of Boise in Idaho.
sentences.zh: 杰拉德是一名包机飞行员，所以有时会一连几天不在家，但他当时得到了一份更稳定的工作，基地在爱达荷州的博伊西。

sentences.en: The couple began to think about their future and what they wanted their retirement to look like.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇开始考虑他们的未来，以及他们想要的退休生活是什么样子的。

sentences.en: They decided to buy a rural property.
sentences.zh: 他们决定买一处乡村房产。

sentences.en: Fixing it up together would be a fun project after Cheryl left her teaching position in Utah.
sentences.zh: 在谢丽尔离开犹他州的教职后，一起修缮房子将是一个有趣的计划。

sentences.en: The couple purchased a farm in the small town of Caldwell on Thursday, May 4, 2017.
sentences.zh: 2017年5月4日，星期四，这对夫妇在考德威尔小镇买下了一个农场。

sentences.en: The plan was for Gerald to move there right away and start working on things that needed fixing, such as the plumbing and painting.
sentences.zh: 计划是让杰拉德立即搬过去，开始处理需要维修的事情，比如管道和粉刷。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Cheryl would keep living at their house in Ogden and get it ready to be sold.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，谢丽尔将继续住在他们奥格登的家里，并为出售做准备。

sentences.en: The couple stayed in touch during their time apart, and on Saturday June 3, they travelled to New Mexico together to attend the wedding of one of Gerald's relatives.
sentences.zh: 分居期间，这对夫妇一直保持联系，6月3日星期六，他们一起前往新墨西哥州参加杰拉德一位亲戚的婚礼。

sentences.en: Several days later, on Tuesday June 6, 57-year-old Cheryl worked her final day at the Greenwood Charter School.
sentences.zh: 几天后的6月6日星期二，57岁的谢丽尔在格林伍德特许学校完成了最后一天的工作。

sentences.en: She was leaving the job to start preparing for her retirement.
sentences.zh: 她辞职是为了开始为退休做准备。

sentences.en: By this time, Cheryl and Gerald had owned the farm in Caldwell for a month, but she still hadn't seen it in person.
sentences.zh: 此时，谢丽尔和杰拉德拥有考德威尔的农场已经一个月了，但她还没亲眼见过它。

sentences.en: Now that she was no longer working, it seemed like the perfect time to surprise Gerald with an impromptu visit.
sentences.zh: 既然她不再工作了，这似乎是给杰拉德一个惊喜、进行一次即兴访问的绝佳时机。

sentences.en: Cheryl wanted to see the farm for herself and also spend some time with her husband.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔想亲自看看农场，也想和丈夫待上一段时间。

sentences.en: On Thursday June 8, she let some friends know that she was headed up to the farm.
sentences.zh: 6月8日星期四，她告诉一些朋友她要动身去农场。

sentences.en: The next time anyone heard from her was several days later, on Sunday June 11.
sentences.zh: 此后，直到几天后的6月11日星期日，才有人再次收到她的消息。

sentences.en: One of Cheryl's friends received a strange text message from her.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔的一位朋友收到了一条来自她的奇怪短信。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 短信写道：

sentences.en: Take care of my dogs.
sentences.zh: 照顾好我的狗。

sentences.en: I don't know if I'm coming back.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我还会不会回来。

sentences.en: When Cheryl's brother heard about this message, he wasn't concerned.
sentences.zh: 当谢丽尔的哥哥听到这条消息时，他并不担心。

sentences.en: Cheryl and Gerald loved to travel, so perhaps they went on a last-minute camping trip somewhere.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔和杰拉德喜欢旅行，所以也许他们去某个地方进行了一次说走就走的露营旅行。

sentences.en: But another week went by with no word from the couple.
sentences.zh: 但又过了一周，这对夫妇依然音讯全无。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in Caldwell, police had received multiple calls requesting welfare checks on Mike Bollinger and Nadia and Peyton Medley.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在考德威尔，警方接到了多个电话，要求对迈克·博林格、纳迪亚·梅德利和佩顿·梅德利进行福利检查。

sentences.en: The three lived on a farmhouse not far out of town and no one had heard from them for ten days.
sentences.zh: 这三人住在城外不远的一个农舍里，已经十天没人听到他们的消息了。

sentences.en: When deputies arrived at the farm, they were met with a grisly scene.
sentences.zh: 当副警长到达农场时，他们看到了一幕惨状。

sentences.en: Multiple pets had died of starvation after being seemingly abandoned.
sentences.zh: 多只宠物在似乎被遗弃后死于饥饿。

sentences.en: Hidden under a tarp in the hayshed were three bodies, believed to be those of the three missing residents.
sentences.zh: 在干草棚的防水布下藏着三具尸体，据信是那三名失踪的住户。

sentences.en: All had been killed with a single, execution-style gunshot to the head.
sentences.zh: 所有人都被行刑式枪击头部，一枪毙命。

sentences.en: Identification at the scene wasn't possible.
sentences.zh: 现场无法进行身份确认。

sentences.en: The summer heat had sped up the decomposition process considerably, and the trio had luckily already been dead for at least a week and a half.
sentences.zh: 夏季的高温大大加快了腐烂过程，幸运的是，这三人实际上已经死亡至少一周半了。

sentences.en: One of the bodies appeared to be that of a woman in her late 40s.
sentences.zh: 其中一具尸体看起来是一名40多岁的女性。

sentences.en: Another belonged to a teenage girl.
sentences.zh: 另一具属于一名十几岁的女孩。

sentences.en: It seemed fairly certain they were Nadia and Peyton Medley.
sentences.zh: 基本可以确定她们是纳迪亚·梅德利和佩顿·梅德利。

sentences.en: But the third body wasn't Mike Bollinger.
sentences.zh: 但第三具尸体不是迈克·博林格。

sentences.en: Mike's full name was Gerald Michael Bollinger, but he typically went by Mike.
sentences.zh: 迈克的全名是杰拉德·迈克尔·博林格，但他通常被称为迈克。

sentences.en: Born in Wyoming in 1957, he grew up surrounded by wilderness, which fostered his interest in the outdoors.
sentences.zh: 他1957年出生于怀俄明州，在荒野中长大，这培养了他对户外活动的兴趣。

sentences.en: His family belonged to the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, also known as the LDS or Mormon Church.
sentences.zh: 他的家人属于耶稣基督后期圣徒教会，也就是通常所说的LDS或摩门教。

sentences.en: It is a branch of Christianity that was founded in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在美国创立的基督教分支。

sentences.en: In 1976, when he was 19 years old, Mike travelled to Manila in the Philippines for his LDS mission.
sentences.zh: 1976年，19岁的迈克前往菲律宾马尼拉执行他的LDS传教任务。

sentences.en: Serving as a missionary is considered a rite of passage for young LDS members, and is a way for the Church to recruit new members all over the world.
sentences.zh: 担任传教士被认为是年轻LDS成员的成年礼，也是教会招募世界各地新成员的一种方式。

sentences.en: When Mike returned to the United States, he began studying at an LDS college in Idaho, where he met another young church member named Jacqueline Garcia, who went by Jackie.
sentences.zh: 当迈克回到美国时，他开始在爱达荷州的一所LDS学院学习，在那里他遇到了另一位年轻的教会成员杰奎琳·加西亚，大家都叫她杰基。

sentences.en: The pair married at the LDS Temple in Salt Lake City, Utah in 1978.
sentences.zh: 两人于1978年在犹他州盐湖城的LDS圣殿结婚。

sentences.en: Almost immediately, Jackie knew she'd made a terrible mistake.
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻，杰基就知道自己犯了一个可怕的错误。

sentences.en: The newlyweds argued a lot, and during one fight,
sentences.zh: 这对新婚夫妇经常争吵，在一次争吵中，

sentences.en: Jackie was sprawled across the floor while Mike loomed over her.
sentences.zh: 杰基瘫倒在地，而迈克则笼罩在她上方。

sentences.en: Jackie saw how angry he looked and asked,
sentences.zh: 杰基看到他看起来有多愤怒，便问：

sentences.en: You wanted to hit me, didn't you?
sentences.zh: 你想打我，对吧？

sentences.en: Mike simply replied,
sentences.zh: 迈克只是回答：

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Eventually, he began acting on this desire and beat Jackie often.
sentences.zh: 最终，他开始付诸行动，经常殴打杰基。

sentences.en: At times, she feared Mike was going to kill her.
sentences.zh: 有时，她担心迈克会杀了她。

sentences.en: He also regularly cheated on her and lied constantly.
sentences.zh: 他还经常欺骗她，并且不断撒谎。

sentences.en: Jackie tried everything she could think of to fix things.
sentences.zh: 杰基尝试了她能想到的一切方法来挽救这段关系。

sentences.en: She contacted Mike's parents to tell them what was going on.
sentences.zh: 她联系了迈克的父母，告诉他们发生了什么事。

sentences.en: She called a domestic violence hotline.
sentences.zh: 她拨打了家庭暴力热线。

sentences.en: She sought couples counselling through the church and sent Mike to therapy aimed at abusive men.
sentences.zh: 她通过教会寻求夫妻咨询，并送迈克去参加针对虐待男性的治疗。

sentences.en: But Mike refused to change his behaviour.
sentences.zh: 但迈克拒绝改变他的行为。

sentences.en: Eventually, Jackie went to her church bishop and asked for help getting a divorce.
sentences.zh: 最终，杰基去找她的教会主教，请求帮助离婚。

sentences.en: A divorce was granted, and in 1988, the pair went their separate ways.
sentences.zh: 离婚获准，1988年，两人分道扬镳。

sentences.en: Jackie was granted sole custody of their two sons, but they still visited their father on occasion.
sentences.zh: 杰基获得了他们两个儿子的唯一监护权，但他们偶尔还是会去看望父亲。

sentences.en: When the boys returned home to Jackie after a stay with their father, the younger one told his mother that Mike had hit him.
sentences.zh: 当孩子们在父亲那里待了一段时间回到杰基身边时，小儿子告诉母亲迈克打了他。

sentences.en: Jackie called Mike and told him he was not to hit their children.
sentences.zh: 杰基打电话给迈克，告诉他不准打他们的孩子。

sentences.en: Mike said nothing, but the next time his sons visited, he sat them both down and said that whatever happened at his house was to stay at his house.
sentences.zh: 迈克什么也没说，但下次儿子们来访时，他让两人坐下，说无论在他家发生了什么，都要留在家里。

sentences.en: Not long after he and Jackie were divorced, Mike Bollinger remarried.
sentences.zh: 他和杰基离婚后不久，迈克·博林格就再婚了。

sentences.en: His second wife was a woman whom he'd been having an affair with.
sentences.zh: 他的第二任妻子是他一直有外遇的一名女子。

sentences.en: Then, years later, Mike met a teacher named Cheryl Baker on a flight to Alaska.
sentences.zh: 后来，几年后，迈克在飞往阿拉斯加的航班上遇到了一位名叫谢丽尔·贝克的老师。

sentences.en: Cheryl had no idea that Mike was already married when they started dating.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔在他们开始约会时根本不知道迈克已经结婚了。

sentences.en: When his wife found out he was cheating, that marriage ended as well.
sentences.zh: 当他的妻子发现他出轨时，那段婚姻也结束了。

sentences.en: Then, Cheryl married Mike in 2010, oblivious to everything that had been going on at his end.
sentences.zh: 然后，谢丽尔在2010年嫁给了迈克，对他在那段期间发生的一切一无所知。

sentences.en: Mike moved into Cheryl's home in Ogden.
sentences.zh: 迈克搬进了谢丽尔在奥格登的家。

sentences.en: As far as anyone could tell, they had a very happy relationship.
sentences.zh: 据所有人所知，他们的关系非常幸福。

sentences.en: Cheryl never shared any complaints or concerns about Mike at all.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔从未分享过任何关于迈克的抱怨或担忧。

sentences.en: Despite his past as a faithful LDS churchgoer,
sentences.zh: 尽管他过去是一名虔诚的LDS教会成员，

sentences.en: with Cheryl he embraced Hinduism like she did.
sentences.zh: 但和谢丽尔在一起后，他像她一样信奉了印度教。

sentences.en: Mike travelled a lot for work, but the couple also found plenty of time to enjoy their hobbies together.
sentences.zh: 迈克经常因工作出差，但这对夫妇也找到了充足的时间一起享受他们的爱好。

sentences.en: Then, in 2015, Mike met the recently widowed Nadia Medley at the massage parlour where she worked.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2015年，迈克在纳迪亚·梅德利工作的按摩院遇到了刚丧偶不久的她。

sentences.en: Mike then initiated an affair with Nadia.
sentences.zh: 迈克随后与纳迪亚开始了婚外情。

sentences.en: Cheryl's loved ones were adamant that she had no idea Mike was being unfaithful.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔的亲人们坚称她根本不知道迈克不忠。

sentences.en: Nadia's friends were equally certain that her strong morals meant she would never have become involved with a married man.
sentences.zh: 纳迪亚的朋友们同样确信，她强烈的道德观念意味着她绝不会与一个已婚男人纠缠不清。

sentences.en: They knew that Mike must have lied about his marital status in order to form a relationship with her.
sentences.zh: 他们知道迈克一定是为了与她建立关系而谎报了自己的婚姻状况。

sentences.en: Plus, she had posted openly about her relationship with Mike on Facebook a number of times.
sentences.zh: 此外，她还在Facebook上多次公开发布过她与迈克的关系。

sentences.en: If they had been having an affair, surely she wouldn't have done that.
sentences.zh: 如果他们有婚外情，她肯定不会那样做。

sentences.en: Given what a small community Ogden was, it was remarkable that no mutual acquaintances of the two women had seen the posts and said something about the matter.
sentences.zh: 考虑到奥格登是一个多么小的社区，令人惊讶的是，这两位女性的共同熟人中竟然没有人看到这些帖子并对此事发表评论。

sentences.en: However, it also appeared that Mike and Cheryl weren't social media users.
sentences.zh: 然而，看起来迈克和谢丽尔也不是社交媒体用户。

sentences.en: Although Nadia shared photos and videos of Mike, he wasn't tagged in any posts.
sentences.zh: 虽然纳迪亚分享了迈克的照片和视频，但他并没有被标记在任何帖子中。

sentences.en: Only later would it come out that Nadia had mentioned a couple of mild concerns to her friends.
sentences.zh: 直到后来才传出纳迪亚曾向朋友提到过一些轻微的担忧。

sentences.en: She thought it was strange that Mike never stayed over at her place and she'd only visited his house once.
sentences.zh: 她觉得奇怪的是，迈克从不在她家过夜，而她也只去过他家一次。

sentences.en: At the time, they put this down to the fact that Mike said it was his first relationship in 10 years.
sentences.zh: 当时，他们把这归因于迈克说这是他10年来第一次恋爱。

sentences.en: Perhaps he felt shy or thought it wasn't appropriate to stay at Nadia's with her teenage daughter in the house.
sentences.zh: 也许他感到害羞，或者认为在纳迪亚家里有十几岁的女儿的情况下过夜不合适。

sentences.en: Nadia's house in Ogden was just 8 miles away from Cheryl's.
sentences.zh: 纳迪亚在奥格登的家距离谢丽尔的家只有8英里。

sentences.en: A couple of years later, in early 2017,
sentences.zh: 几年后，在2017年初，

sentences.en: Mike convinced Cheryl to buy a farm in Caldwell with him, saying it could be their retirement home.
sentences.zh: 迈克说服谢丽尔和他一起在考德威尔买了一个农场，说这可以作为他们的退休住所。

sentences.en: Cheryl borrowed money against the house she already owned to finance the purchase, which was made in her name.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔用她名下已有的房子抵押贷款来资助这次购买，房产登记在她的名下。

sentences.en: The same day that the purchase of the farm was finalised,
sentences.zh: 就在农场购买完成的同一天，

sentences.en: Nadia and her daughter Peyton moved to Caldwell.
sentences.zh: 纳迪亚和她的女儿佩顿搬到了考德威尔。

sentences.en: Investigators couldn't understand why Mike would move Nadia and Peyton into a home that was owned by his wife, who thought she would be joining him there soon.
sentences.zh: 调查人员无法理解为什么迈克会把纳迪亚和佩顿搬进他妻子名下的房子里，而妻子还以为她很快就会搬去和他住在一起。

sentences.en: They wondered if Mike's plan had been to kill Cheryl after using her to buy the Caldwell property so he could form a full-time family with Nadia and Peyton.
sentences.zh: 他们怀疑迈克的计划是否是在利用谢丽尔买下考德威尔的房产后杀掉她，这样他就可以和纳迪亚及佩顿组成一个全职家庭。

sentences.en: Perhaps when Cheryl had decided to make an unannounced visit, this plan had been foiled.
sentences.zh: 也许当谢丽尔决定进行一次不速之客的访问时，这个计划就泡汤了。

sentences.en: The Caldwell property was large, but it wasn't isolated.
sentences.zh: 考德威尔的房产很大，但并不偏僻。

sentences.en: There was another house about 50 feet away on one side and a second about 30 feet away.
sentences.zh: 一侧约50英尺处有另一栋房子，另一侧约30英尺处还有第二栋。

sentences.en: A neighbour said she'd heard what sounded like a woman screaming in the middle of the night sometime between June 6 and June 10.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居说，在6月6日至6月10日之间的某个深夜，她听到过听起来像女人尖叫的声音。

sentences.en: But she couldn't be sure if it was a person or an animal, so she hadn't reported it to the police.
sentences.zh: 但她不能确定那是人还是动物，所以没有向警方报告。

sentences.en: Others thought they'd heard gunshots on or around June 10.
sentences.zh: 其他人认为他们在6月10日左右听到了枪声。

sentences.en: They hadn't thought anything of it at the time as it wasn't unusual to hear shooting in the rural area.
sentences.zh: 他们当时没多想，因为在这个农村地区听到枪声并不罕见。

sentences.en: DNA confirmed that the three bodies found in the farm's hayshed were those of Cheryl Baker and Nadia and Peyton Medley.
sentences.zh: DNA证实，在农场干草棚中发现的三具尸体分别是谢丽尔·贝克、纳迪亚·梅德利和佩顿·梅德利。

sentences.en: The last time anyone had heard from Nadia or Peyton was on Thursday June 8, the same day that Cheryl drove to the farm.
sentences.zh: 最后一次有人收到纳迪亚或佩顿的消息是在6月8日星期四，也就是谢丽尔开车去农场的那一天。

sentences.en: Detectives suspected that Cheryl had arrived at a time when Mike wasn't around.
sentences.zh: 侦探们怀疑谢丽尔到达时迈克并不在场。

sentences.en: Finding Nadia there instead, Cheryl began to talk to the other woman and the two of them figured out that they had both been manipulated and lied to by the same man.
sentences.zh: 发现纳迪亚在那里，谢丽尔开始与对方交谈，两人发现她们都被同一个男人操纵和欺骗了。

sentences.en: Then, Mike returned home and became enraged upon realising his deceit had been found out.
sentences.zh: 然后，迈克回到家，在意识到他的欺骗行为被发现后变得暴跳如雷。

sentences.en: Maybe Cheryl had threatened to divorce him, leaving him with no assets as both property deeds were in her name.
sentences.zh: 也许谢丽尔威胁要和他离婚，让他一无所有，因为两处房产的契约都在她名下。

sentences.en: He then shot dead all three women, including the teenager who viewed him as a father, to avoid the consequences of his actions.
sentences.zh: 为了逃避行为后果，他随后枪杀了所有三名女性，包括那个视他为父亲的少女。

sentences.en: But then, there was the strange text message
sentences.zh: 但随后，还有那条奇怪的短信，

sentences.en: Cheryl had sent to a friend on June 11, asking for them to look after her dogs because she might not return.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔在6月11日发给一位朋友，请求他们照顾她的狗，因为她可能回不来了。

sentences.en: Investigators believed Mike might have sent this message from Cheryl's phone.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为迈克可能用谢丽尔的手机发送了这条信息。

sentences.en: The fact that he was nowhere to be found indicated he had gone on the run and he had a 10-day head start on investigators.
sentences.zh: 他不见踪影的事实表明他已经潜逃，并且比调查人员领先了10天。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您支持Casefile继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Mike Bollinger's photograph was shared widely throughout Idaho and Utah in the hope he might be recognised.
sentences.zh: 迈克·博林格的照片在爱达荷州和犹他州被广泛分享，希望能被认出来。

sentences.en: He was 60 years old, 140 pounds, and 6 foot 1, with grey hair and brown eyes.
sentences.zh: 他60岁，140磅，6英尺1英寸高，灰发棕眼。

sentences.en: Soon, tips were flooding in from people who had seen him.
sentences.zh: 很快，来自见过他的人的线索纷至沓来。

sentences.en: On Saturday June 10,
sentences.zh: 6月10日星期六，

sentences.en: Mike had breakfast in Nampa, a city just 10 miles southeast of Caldwell.
sentences.zh: 迈克在南帕吃早餐，那是一个距离考德威尔仅10英里的城市。

sentences.en: Then, he drove his pickup truck all the way back to Ogden, Utah.
sentences.zh: 然后，他开着皮卡车一路回到了犹他州的奥格登。

sentences.en: He went to a local dealership where a 2007 Ford Focus that he and Cheryl had owned was being serviced.
sentences.zh: 他去了当地的一家经销商处，那里正在维修他和谢丽尔拥有的一辆2007年福特福克斯。

sentences.en: Mike picked up the car and began to drive it instead of his truck.
sentences.zh: 迈克取回了这辆车，开始开它，而不是他的皮卡车。

sentences.en: On either June 11 or June 12, a surveillance camera in Swan Valley, Idaho, captured Mike entering the city.
sentences.zh: 在6月11日或6月12日，爱达荷州斯旺谷的一个监控摄像头拍到了迈克进入该市的画面。

sentences.en: He had driven back to the state he had fled.
sentences.zh: 他开车回到了他逃离的州。

sentences.en: The day after that, another surveillance camera caught the moment that Mike paid an entrance fee to the Bridger-Teton National Forest, located east of Idaho in Wyoming.
sentences.zh: 第二天，另一个监控摄像头拍到了迈克支付进入布里杰-提顿国家森林门票的瞬间，该森林位于爱达荷州东部的怀俄明州。

sentences.en: The Bridger-Teton National Forest is a 3.4 million acre forest that sprawls across western Wyoming.
sentences.zh: 布里杰-提顿国家森林是一片占地340万英亩的森林，横跨怀俄明州西部。

sentences.en: It sits adjacent to the Grand Teton and Yellowstone National Parks, and is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts who love camping and hiking.
sentences.zh: 它毗邻大提顿国家公园和黄石国家公园，是热爱露营和徒步旅行的户外爱好者的天堂。

sentences.en: On Wednesday July 12, approximately one month after the triple homicide,
sentences.zh: 7月12日星期三，即三起谋杀案发生约一个月后，

sentences.en: Mike Bollinger's 2007 Ford Focus was discovered parked at the Forest's Pacific Creek Campground.
sentences.zh: 迈克·博林格的2007年福特福克斯被发现停在森林的太平洋溪露营地。

sentences.en: It was a remote campsite and it seemed the car had been left there for some time.
sentences.zh: 那是一个偏远的露营地，看起来车已经在那里停了很长时间了。

sentences.en: Investigators were aware that Mike was a competent outdoorsman who would have no issues with trekking into the nearby wilderness.
sentences.zh: 调查人员知道迈克是一个能干的户外运动者，进入附近的荒野对他来说没有任何问题。

sentences.en: His experience as a pilot might have meant he was also familiar with the forest from the air.
sentences.zh: 他作为飞行员的经验可能意味着他也从空中熟悉这片森林。

sentences.en: Law enforcement used police dogs, infrared technology, and helicopters to scour the area.
sentences.zh: 执法部门使用了警犬、红外技术和直升机来搜查该地区。

sentences.en: It was difficult terrain to navigate on foot due to the rocky ground and thick vegetation.
sentences.zh: 由于岩石地面和茂密的植被，在地面上导航非常困难。

sentences.en: Because Mike was considered armed and dangerous, searchers were on high alert the entire time, just in case he tried to ambush them.
sentences.zh: 因为迈克被认为持有武器且危险，搜查人员全程保持高度警惕，以防他伏击他们。

sentences.en: Local communities and subdivisions were also checked, as were abandoned farmhouses.
sentences.zh: 当地社区和住宅区也受到了检查，废弃的农舍也是如此。

sentences.en: But no trace of Mike Bollinger was found.
sentences.zh: 但没有发现迈克·博林格的踪迹。

sentences.en: One week after the Ford Focus was discovered, park rangers in nearby Yellowstone National Park spotted an SUV being driven by a light-haired man.
sentences.zh: 在福特福克斯被发现一周后，附近黄石国家公园的公园管理员发现了一辆由一名浅色头发男子驾驶的SUV。

sentences.en: The vehicle was similar to the sort law enforcement thought Mike might have acquired if he'd left a bridge at Teton National ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 这辆车与执法部门认为迈克如果离开提顿国家森林可能会获得的车辆类型相似。

sentences.en: Two rangers pursued the SUV in two separate vehicles, forcing the driver to pull over.
sentences.zh: 两名管理员驾驶两辆不同的车辆追赶这辆SUV，迫使司机靠边停车。

sentences.en: Also in the car was a woman and a seven-year-old girl.
sentences.zh: 车里还有一名妇女和一个七岁的女孩。

sentences.en: The rangers blocked in the vehicle and soon more law enforcement officers arrived.
sentences.zh: 护林员封锁了车辆，不久后更多执法人员赶到。

sentences.en: After about an hour, they permitted the driver to show them his identification.
sentences.zh: 大约一小时后，他们允许司机出示身份证件。

sentences.en: His name was Brett.
sentences.zh: 他叫布雷特。

sentences.en: The passengers in the car were his wife and daughter and they were on vacation from Missouri.
sentences.zh: 车上的乘客是他的妻子和女儿，他们是从密苏里州来度假的。

sentences.en: The officers explained that they were looking for a wanted killer and showed Brett a photograph of Mike Bollinger.
sentences.zh: 警官们解释说他们正在寻找一名通缉杀手，并向布雷特展示了迈克·博林格的照片。

sentences.en: Brett couldn't see any resemblance, except that they both had light grey hair.
sentences.zh: 布雷特看不出有什么相似之处，除了他们都有灰白的头发。

sentences.en: The family were permitted to leave.
sentences.zh: 这家人获准离开。

sentences.en: News later broke that they were planning to sue the officers, alleging that they had held them at gunpoint for an hour with no explanation.
sentences.zh: 后来有新闻爆出，他们计划起诉这些警官，声称警官在没有任何解释的情况下用枪指着他们扣留了一个小时。

sentences.en: Other sightings of the wanted fugitive continued to trickle in.
sentences.zh: 关于这名通缉逃犯的其他目击报告不断传来。

sentences.en: Someone thought they'd seen Mike driving in Salt Lake City.
sentences.zh: 有人以为在盐湖城看到了迈克开车。

sentences.en: After Mike's Ford was found, a river guide in Idaho spotted some men by Henry's Fork, a tributary of the Snake River.
sentences.zh: 在迈克的福特车被发现后，爱达荷州的一名河流向导在蛇河的一条支流——亨利叉河边发现了几名男子。

sentences.en: The guide thought the men were behaving suspiciously.
sentences.zh: 向导认为这些人的行为很可疑。

sentences.en: One of them looked like Mike.
sentences.zh: 其中一人看起来像迈克。

sentences.en: None of these sightings could be confirmed.
sentences.zh: 这些目击报告都无法得到证实。

sentences.en: Investigators considered the possibility that Mike had taken his own life somewhere deep in the foreSt.
sentences.zh: 调查人员考虑了迈克可能在森林深处自杀的可能性。

sentences.en: However, they wondered why he would travel so far from home in the days after the murders if he'd planned on killing himself.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们纳闷的是，如果他打算自杀，为什么要在谋杀案发生后的几天里跑得离家那么远？

sentences.en: Why not do so at the farm back in Caldwell?
sentences.zh: 为什么不在考德威尔的老家农场动手呢？

sentences.en: Perhaps he had hitched a ride with another car out of the forest and left his Ford Focus abandoned there to shake the police off his tail.
sentences.zh: 也许他是搭了另一辆车的顺风车离开了森林，并把他的福特福克斯遗弃在那里，以甩掉警察的追踪。

sentences.en: In an interview with newspaper The Idaho Statesman,
sentences.zh: 在接受《爱达荷政治家报》采访时，

sentences.en: Mike's first wife, Jackie Garcia, described Mike as a prolific liar and possibly a sociopath.
sentences.zh: 迈克的第一任妻子杰基·加西亚称迈克是一个惯犯，可能是一个反社会人格者。

sentences.en: Another person who knew Mike but wished to remain anonymous agreed.
sentences.zh: 另一位认识迈克但希望保持匿名的人也表示同意。

sentences.en: A friend of Nadia Medley also spoke to the newspaper, saying she felt Mike was too egotistical to take his own life.
sentences.zh: 纳迪亚·梅德利的一位朋友也对该报表示，她觉得迈克太自负了，不会自杀。

sentences.en: In late 2017, a family was hiking in Bridgeteton National Forest near the Pacific Creek Campground.
sentences.zh: 2017年底，一家人在太平洋溪露营地附近的布里奇顿国家森林徒步旅行。

sentences.en: They came across a junction where two trails met.
sentences.zh: 他们遇到了两条小径交汇的岔路口。

sentences.en: Standing there was a dishevelled man who looked to be in his early 60s.
sentences.zh: 那里站着一个衣衫褴褛的男子，看起来有60岁出头。

sentences.en: He was alone and looked ill-equipped to be hiking in winter.
sentences.zh: 他独自一人，看起来装备不足，不适合在冬天徒步旅行。

sentences.en: He had no backpack, water or safety protection and his face was very weathered.
sentences.zh: 他没有背包、水或安全防护装备，脸部饱经风霜。

sentences.en: The man passed by the family and kept his head down the entire time.
sentences.zh: 那名男子从这家人身边经过，全程低着头。

sentences.en: When investigators heard about the interaction, they suspected the man could have been Mike Bollinger.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员听说这次互动时，他们怀疑那个人可能是迈克·博林格。

sentences.en: Months went by with no further developments in the case.
sentences.zh: 几个月过去了，案件没有任何进展。

sentences.en: Then, in mid-2018, a gun was found in Pacific Creek.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2018年中期，太平洋溪中发现了一把枪。

sentences.en: It was closer to Yellowstone National Park than the Bridgeteton Forest and was fully loaded.
sentences.zh: 它比布里奇顿森林更靠近黄石国家公园，而且弹匣是满的。

sentences.en: Investigators wondered if it belonged to Mike, but it was in good condition and didn't look as though it had been exposed to the elements.
sentences.zh: 调查人员怀疑它是否属于迈克，但它状况良好，看起来不像是在户外暴露过。

sentences.en: More than a year after the murders, in August 2018, authorities regrouped and carried out another search of the Bridgeteton ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生一年多后，即2018年8月，当局重新集结，对布里奇顿森林进行了另一次搜查。

sentences.en: Roughly 20 investigators from multiple agencies split into four groups to cover a four-mile radius of wilderness north of the Pacific Creek Campground.
sentences.zh: 来自多个机构的大约20名调查人员分成四组，覆盖了太平洋溪露营地以北四英里半径的荒野区域。

sentences.en: They started at the junction where a family had spotted a suspicious-looking man at the end of 2017.
sentences.zh: 他们从2017年底一家人发现可疑男子的那个路口开始搜查。

sentences.en: Cadaver dogs went with them.
sentences.zh: 搜尸犬随行。

sentences.en: If Mike was still in the forest, investigators doubted that he was still alive.
sentences.zh: 如果迈克还在森林里，调查人员怀疑他是否还活着。

sentences.en: It had snowed towards the end of 2017, and the snow line was right by the Pacific Creek Campground.
sentences.zh: 2017年底下过雪，雪线就在太平洋溪露营地附近。

sentences.en: Mike would have had to survive a bitterly cold winter without any proper gear or provisions.
sentences.zh: 迈克必须在没有任何适当装备或补给的情况下，在严寒的冬天生存下来。

sentences.en: Even for an experienced hunter and guide like him, that would have been extremely difficult.
sentences.zh: 即使对于像他这样经验丰富的猎人和向导来说，这也极其困难。

sentences.en: The forest was also home to grizzly bears, wolves, and mountain lions.
sentences.zh: 森林里还有灰熊、狼和美洲狮。

sentences.en: If Mike hadn't taken his own life or died from the elements, there was every possibility that he'd been killed by a predatory animal.
sentences.zh: 如果迈克不是自杀或死于恶劣天气，他完全有可能被掠食性动物杀死。

sentences.en: Searchers didn't recover Mike's remains, however, they did find some other kind of evidence.
sentences.zh: 搜寻人员没有找到迈克的遗骸，但他们确实发现了其他证据。

sentences.en: They wouldn't say publicly what this evidence was, but they told the media it indicated Mike had never left the forest and had died in there.
sentences.zh: 他们没有公开这些证据是什么，但他们告诉媒体，这表明迈克从未离开过森林，并死在了里面。

sentences.en: They put out a bulletin advising people visiting the forest throughout the summer and fall to keep an eye out for anything that looked like scattered clothing or human remains.
sentences.zh: 他们发布了一份公告，建议整个夏季和秋季访问森林的人留意任何看起来像散落的衣物或人类遗骸的东西。

sentences.en: If Mike had died during the winter, then wildlife would have scavenged his remains when the snow thawed.
sentences.zh: 如果迈克在冬天死亡，那么当积雪融化时，野生动物就会清理他的遗骸。

sentences.en: Nothing of significance was ever recovered.
sentences.zh: 没有发现任何有价值的东西。

sentences.en: Enough evidence was found in Mike's abandoned Ford Focus and at both of his properties to confirm he was responsible for killing Cheryl, Nadia and Payton.
sentences.zh: 在迈克遗弃的福特福克斯车内以及他的两处房产中发现的证据足以证实他是杀害谢丽尔、纳迪亚和佩顿的凶手。

sentences.en: Detectives have not publicly disclosed what that evidence is.
sentences.zh: 侦探们尚未公开披露这些证据的具体内容。

sentences.en: Mike Bollinger has formally been charged with three counts of first-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 迈克·博林格已被正式指控犯有三项一级谋杀罪。

sentences.en: Yet, as of late 2022, law enforcement remains confident that he is no longer alive.
sentences.zh: 然而，截至2022年底，执法部门仍然确信他已经不在人世了。

sentences.en: Mike Bollinger was described as a chameleon who could mould himself to be whatever a particular woman wanted.
sentences.zh: 迈克·博林格被描述为一个变色龙，可以把自己塑造成任何特定女性想要的样子。

sentences.en: With his first wife, Jackie, he was an LDS churchgoer like she was.
sentences.zh: 和第一任妻子杰基在一起时，他像她一样去耶稣基督后期圣徒教会做礼拜。

sentences.en: When he met Cheryl, he began attending a Hindu temple with her and even learnt Sanskrit.
sentences.zh: 当他遇到谢丽尔时，他开始和她一起去印度教寺庙，甚至学习了梵语。

sentences.en: Then, with Nadia, who was an avowed atheist, he said he didn't believe in God either.
sentences.zh: 然后，对于公开的无神论者纳迪亚，他说他也不相信上帝。

sentences.en: Those who met Mike described him as warm and charming.
sentences.zh: 见过迈克的人都形容他热情而迷人。

sentences.en: He had a charismatic personality and was romantically involved with many women.
sentences.zh: 他个性富有魅力，与许多女性有过浪漫关系。

sentences.en: Some wondered if he had found another woman to con and was living in hiding with her somewhere.
sentences.zh: 有些人怀疑他是否找到了另一个女人来欺骗，并和她躲在某个地方生活。

sentences.en: Others speculated that maybe Mike had used his pilot's licence to fly out of the country and start a new life overseas, though no evidence has been found to support this.
sentences.zh: 另一些人推测，也许迈克利用他的飞行员执照飞往国外，在海外开始了新的生活，尽管没有证据支持这一点。

sentences.en: Cheryl Baker is remembered as a kind, gentle and creative woman as well as an excellent teacher.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔·贝克被人们铭记为一位善良、温柔、富有创造力的女性，也是一位优秀的教师。

sentences.en: For over 30 years, she worked at the Utah School for the Deaf and Blind, teaching children with hearing impairments.
sentences.zh: 30多年来，她在犹他州聋盲学校工作，教导有听力障碍的孩子。

sentences.en: Sometimes, she bought school supplies and clothing for students who couldn't afford them, and she also searched for funding grants for the school.
sentences.zh: 有时，她会为买不起学习用品和衣服的学生购买这些物品，她还为学校寻找资助拨款。

sentences.en: In 2011, her hard work was recognised when she was awarded Teacher of the Year by the University of Utah College of Education.
sentences.zh: 2011年，她的辛勤工作得到了认可，被犹他大学教育学院授予年度教师奖。

sentences.en: Her final job at Greenwood Charter School saw her teaching art classes.
sentences.zh: 她在格林伍德特许学校的最后一份工作是教授艺术课。

sentences.en: This was a perfect fit for Cheryl, who was a talented artist herself.
sentences.zh: 这对谢丽尔来说非常合适，她本人也是一位才华横溢的艺术家。

sentences.en: At the Utah School for the Deaf and Blind, a memorial bench has been installed in Cheryl's honour.
sentences.zh: 在犹他州聋盲学校，为了纪念谢丽尔，安装了一张纪念长椅。

sentences.en: Two months after the murders, Nadia Medley's brother-in-law, Mark Medley, visited the farmhouse where she and Peyton were killed.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生两个月后，纳迪亚·梅德利的姐夫马克·梅德利参观了她和佩顿被杀的农舍。

sentences.en: He had to sort through their personal belongings and found the ordeal very upsetting.
sentences.zh: 他不得不整理她们的个人物品，并发现这段经历非常令人痛苦。

sentences.en: Mark has described Nadia as independent and stoic, with a deeply nurturing side.
sentences.zh: 马克形容纳迪亚独立而坚忍，有着深沉的母性一面。

sentences.en: This side was most evident when she was caring for her many pets and in how she was raising her daughter, Peyton.
sentences.zh: 当她照顾许多宠物以及抚养女儿佩顿的方式时，这一面最为明显。

sentences.en: When Nadia and Peyton were killed, Mark Medley had been in the process of rebuilding his relationship with them.
sentences.zh: 当纳迪亚和佩顿被杀时，马克·梅德利正处于与她们重建关系的进程中。

sentences.en: He lived interstate, but had recently been getting to know his niece better via phone calls and emails.
sentences.zh: 他住在州外，但最近一直通过电话和电子邮件更好地了解他的侄女。

sentences.en: In one interview, he stated,
sentences.zh: 在一次采访中，他说道，

sentences.en: It felt like Peyton and I were just starting to get to know each other, and then this happens.
sentences.zh: 感觉佩顿和我才刚刚开始了解彼此，然后就发生了这种事。

sentences.en: It's a hard pill to swallow.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个难以接受的事实。

sentences.en: Peyton had her own YouTube channel where she posted videos about her life.
sentences.zh: 佩顿有自己的YouTube频道，她在上面发布关于她生活的视频。

sentences.en: In one, she painted her mother's face blue and purple with glitter to resemble the galaxy.
sentences.zh: 在其中一个视频里，她把母亲的脸涂成蓝色和紫色，并加上亮粉，看起来像星系一样。

sentences.en: In her final video, which was posted around New Year's of 2017, she talked about how she wanted to do things that would make her happy and encouraged viewers to do the same.
sentences.zh: 在她最后一段视频中，发布于2017年新年左右，她谈到了自己想做让自己快乐的事情，并鼓励观众也这样做。

sentences.en: Do something that will impact your life for the better.
sentences.zh: 去做一些能让你的生活变得更好的事情。

sentences.en: Don't just wait for the right moment, because guess what?
sentences.zh: 不要只是等待合适的时机，因为你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: There will never be a bright moment.
sentences.zh: 永远不会有完美的时机。

sentences.en: We don't have enough time in this world to just keep waiting for the bright moment, because eventually we'll just give up.
sentences.zh: 我们在这个世界上没有足够的时间一直等待完美的时机，因为最终我们会放弃。

sentences.en: What we wanted to do won't seem important.
sentences.zh: 我们想做的事情看起来就不重要了。

sentences.en: We'll lost the intereSt.
sentences.zh: 我们会失去兴趣。

sentences.en: And we'll just live our lives not knowing, you know, that we did that.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就会过着我们的生活，却不知道，你知道，我们曾经那样做过。

sentences.en: We'll just live our lives in the what-ifs.
sentences.zh: 我们只会活在“如果当初”的假设中。

sentences.en: And that's not okay.
sentences.zh: 那是不对的。

sentences.en: You need to put yourself out there, because we have one short life.
sentences.zh: 你需要走出去，因为我们只有短暂的一生。

sentences.en: And no matter what you believe happens afterwards, we have one life, and you need to live it the way you want to.
sentences.zh: 无论你相信之后会发生什么，我们只有这一生，你需要按照你想要的方式去生活。
